EXPERIMENTAL MACHINE LEARNING

What might the next daily price be?

RIDGE REGRESSION

Trained on up to a year of Kalshi daily prices. This model forecasts the next daily closing midpoint, not who will win the election.

Loading trained model…

Inspect the backtest and model assumptions

Five inputs: current price, 1-, 3- and 7-day price changes, and 7-day volatility. A standardized ridge regression (fixed alpha 10) predicts the next change. Each party and chamber is trained separately.

We refit using only earlier observations for each of the last 60 test days. The no-change baseline predicts the last price again. Lower mean absolute error (MAE) is better. No election results, polls, fundamentals or other market feeds are used for training. This backtest is not evidence of election-outcome accuracy.

ContractModel MAENo-change MAETest daysTraining examples

Completed daily candles only; invalid prices and gaps are excluded. No missing prices are invented. Forecasts are clipped to 0–100%. No calibrated confidence interval is claimed. Daily boundaries follow the exchange and can shift with daylight saving time.

BEHIND THE NUMBERS

A market snapshot.
Not a certainty.

Polymarket supplies Yes outcome prices. Kalshi and PredictIt use the midpoint between the best Yes bid and ask. Prices reflect traders’ expectations; fees, liquidity and settlement rules can cause differences.

Sources, timing & calculation

Prices are shown independently and may not add to 100%. The market average is a simple descriptive mean of the sources shown as eligible in the table, without normalization or accuracy weighting.

“Retrieved” records a successful API retrieval, not the last trade. After two hours a snapshot is marked stale and excluded from the average. Quote timestamps are not consistently supplied. A failed request retains the earlier snapshot and its original time.

Polymarket can refresh directly while this page is open. All sources and the README refresh through GitHub Actions hourly; schedules may be delayed. The model retrains after its daily forecast expires. Browser refresh reloads saved data too.
